title: Promissory Note to John Brassfield, 16 April 1839
handwriting: Handwriting of Alexander McRae and JS
source_note: [JS], Promissory Note, Missouri, to John Brassfield, 16 Apr. 1839; handwriting of Alexander McRae and JS; probable signature of JS (now missing); one page; JS Collection, CHL. Single leaf measuring 4 × 7½ inches (10 × 19 cm). The left and top edges have the square cut of manufactured paper. The right and bottom edges are unevenly torn. The document was folded for carrying and filing. The bottom right portion, where one or more signatures would have appeared, was subsequently torn off. A portion of the first letter of a signature remains, possibly a “J”. The promissory note was likely in the possession of John Brassfield until it was redeemed, whereupon it passed into possession of the LDS church.
